worldcombat.skill.softboiled.summary: Lays an egg that holds a heal; it ripens in place, and the beneficiary must walk up and peck it open to restore about half of maximum health. The egg stays in the world and can be smashed by an enemy before it ripens (then the heal is lost); a full-health body never feeds, so the egg waits until its lifetime ends. With Share on it is left for a wounded nearby ally instead, at the cost of your own heal.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.use.0: Leave a heal nearby and take it in your own time
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.use.1: Lay the egg somewhere safe, let it ripen, then come back for it
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.use.2: Leave the egg for a wounded companion to come and feed on
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.description: Lays an egg at your feet that ripens after %2$s; only when the beneficiary walks up and pecks it open do they restore %1$s of their maximum health. The egg stays in the world with 6 HP and can be smashed before it ripens; a full-health body never feeds, so the egg waits until its lifetime ends.
Wind-up %1$s and recovery %2$s, shortened by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.stance.shar: Share: only castable while a wounded ally with line of sight is in range; the egg is left for the nearest wounded ally within %1$s blocks, who restores %2$s of their own maximum health when they come to feed, at the cost of the caster's own heal.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.stance.self: Self: only castable while below full health; the egg stays where it is laid and restores %1$s of your own maximum health when you come back to feed — leaving does not heal you.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.softboiled.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
On: hand the egg to a wounded nearby ally who heals by the same fraction, at the cost of the caster's own heal. Off: keep it for yourself.
The companion lays an egg below this health ratio; lower endures longer, higher lays one at the first wound.
world_combat.move.softboiled.text.shared: A companion feeds on the egg (+%1$s)
